user_query: Which binary operator did node2vec use most successfully on average across all networks, and what was the stated reason for highlighting it?
llm_response: node2vec found the Hadamard (element-wise product) operator to be the most successful on average across the evaluated networks. It was highlighted because it consistently performed best overall in link prediction, making it the strongest and most reliable choice among the tested binary operators.
llm_confidence_reasoning: This matches the commonly reported node2vec result that Hadamard performed best on average and was emphasized for its consistently strong performance across networks.
